name: 02-first-look-desktop
description: The same tour on a computer: every module, and what sits inside each one.

steps.caption: Control: a remote, a button or a fader, pointed at anything on this page.
Layouts: where your lights are. Grid sets their shape.
Grid: width, height and depth, applied while it runs.
A computer is not a board: it has the memory and the bandwidth for a big one.
128 by 128 is 16,384 lights, resized while it renders.
Effects: what the lights show, stacked in layers.
Layer: one effect and its modifiers, blended onto the ones below.
Drivers: how the finished frame leaves. A computer has no LED pins, so it previews and sends over the network.
LightPresets: the named wirings every driver refers to.
Preview: the picture on this page, which is a driver like any other.
System: the device itself, its name, its uptime, how fast it renders.
Tasks: what runs each frame, and what each costs.
I2cScan: finds the chips on the I2C bus.
Pins: which pin every module has claimed.
File Manager: every file on the device, and one button that backs them all up.
Network: the connection, and the other devices it can see.
Mqtt: a broker, for a home automation system.
Devices: every other MoonLight on the network, found on their own.
Services: the inputs.
Audio: synthesized out of the box, so the effects react before a microphone is wired.
Firmware: on a computer it downloads the next release for you.
MoonCloud: see what everyone else is running.
Stats: what this device shares, and the totals it gets back.
Talk: ask a question without leaving the page.
